# One template per block: `=== <name> <bas|cls>`, then the module text. `{k}` is replaced by each keyword.
=== localdim bas
Sub Probe()
    Dim {k} As Long
End Sub
=== moddim bas
Dim {k} As Long
=== sub bas
Sub {k}()
End Sub
=== func bas
Function {k}() As Long
End Function
=== const bas
Const {k} = 1
=== type bas
Type {k}
    a As Long
End Type
=== enum bas
Enum {k}
    a
End Enum
=== tmember bas
Type T
    {k} As Long
End Type
=== emember bas
Enum E
    {k}
End Enum
=== param bas
Sub Probe({k} As Long)
End Sub
=== label bas
Sub Probe()
    {k}:
End Sub
=== forvar bas
Sub Probe()
    Dim i As Long
    For {k} = 1 To 2
    Next
End Sub
=== declare bas
Declare Sub {k} Lib "kernel32" ()
=== propget bas
Property Get {k}() As Long
End Property
=== staticdim bas
Sub Probe()
    Static {k} As Long
End Sub
=== redim bas
Sub Probe()
    ReDim {k}(1)
End Sub
=== withevents cls
VERSION 1.0 CLASS
BEGIN
  MultiUse = -1  'True
END
Attribute VB_Name = "Class1"
Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False
Attribute VB_Creatable = True
Attribute VB_PredeclaredId = False
Attribute VB_Exposed = False
Private WithEvents {k} As Class1
=== event cls
VERSION 1.0 CLASS
BEGIN
  MultiUse = -1  'True
END
Attribute VB_Name = "Class1"
Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False
Attribute VB_Creatable = True
Attribute VB_PredeclaredId = False
Attribute VB_Exposed = False
Event {k}()
=== implements cls
VERSION 1.0 CLASS
BEGIN
  MultiUse = -1  'True
END
Attribute VB_Name = "Class1"
Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False
Attribute VB_Creatable = True
Attribute VB_PredeclaredId = False
Attribute VB_Exposed = False
Implements {k}
=== propset bas
Property Set {k}(v As Object)
End Property
=== proplet bas
Property Let {k}(v As Long)
End Property
=== dimarray bas
Dim {k}(1 To 2) As Long
=== paramopt bas
Sub Probe(Optional {k} As Long)
End Sub
=== parambyval bas
Sub Probe(ByVal {k} As Long)
End Sub
=== paramarray bas
Sub Probe(ParamArray {k}() As Variant)
End Sub
=== localconst bas
Sub Probe()
    Const {k} = 1
End Sub
=== lettarget bas
Sub Probe()
    {k} = 1
End Sub
=== startcall bas
Sub Probe()
    {k}
End Sub
=== startarg bas
Sub Probe()
    {k} 1
End Sub
=== startargs bas
Sub Probe()
    {k} 1, 2
End Sub
=== startparen bas
Sub Probe()
    {k}(1)
End Sub
=== startparens bas
Sub Probe()
    {k} (1)
End Sub
=== startdot bas
Sub Probe()
    {k}.x = 1
End Sub
=== startbang bas
Sub Probe()
    {k}!x = 1
End Sub
=== startcomma bas
Sub Probe()
    {k}, 1
End Sub
=== starthash bas
Sub Probe()
    {k} #1
End Sub
=== startcolonstmt bas
Sub Probe()
    {k}: x = 1
End Sub
=== startindexed bas
Sub Probe()
    {k}(1) = 2
End Sub
=== tmemberbounds bas
Type T
    {k}(1) As Long
End Type
=== enumvalue bas
Enum E
    {k} = 1
End Enum
=== constarr bas
Const {k}(1) = 1
=== dimas bas
Dim a As {k}
=== paramas bas
Sub Probe(a As {k})
End Sub
=== foreachcoll bas
Sub Probe()
    For Each x In {k}
    Next
End Sub
=== foreachcollcall bas
Sub Probe()
    For Each x In {k}(1)
    Next
End Sub
=== nextvar bas
Sub Probe()
    For i = 1 To 2
    Next {k}
End Sub
